# PayUrShare

> Scan a restaurant receipt and split the bill item by item with friends — no signup required.

PayUrShare reads the items and prices off a photo of your receipt, lets you assign each dish to
the person who ordered it, splits taxes, service charges and tips proportionally or equally, and
then helps everyone pay the person who covered the bill.

## Pages

- [PayUrShare](/): Scan a receipt, add people, assign items, and see who owes what.
- [SplitBill vs Splitwise](/compare/splitwise): How PayUrShare compares to Splitwise for restaurant bills.
